description: This file manages a registry of media understanding providers, including functions to build the registry, merge providers, and retrieve providers by ID. It also auto-registers image-capable providers based on configuration.

methods.name: mergeProviderIntoRegistry
methods.description: Merges a media understanding provider into the registry, updating existing entries with new capabilities and models.

methods.name: buildMediaUnderstandingRegistry
methods.description: Constructs a registry of media understanding providers, including auto-registration based on configuration and overrides.

methods.name: getMediaUnderstandingProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a media understanding provider from the registry by its ID.
